svg.aria-label: AI Nutrition Facts for HARPY, a budgeted oversight simulation. Privacy ladder not applicable (synthetic data); runs offline; model type: simulation with a mock detector; base model: none, with optional gpt-4.1 replay. Trust ingredients: no training on customer data, no data shared with a vendor, human in the loop with capped alerts. Compliance: logging and auditing, guardrails, input/output consistency, budget enforcement, preregistered decisions and blame tracing are all yes, each backed by named requirements. Detector accuracy is assumed, not measured; external validation not available. 37 requirements: 35 verified by tests or CI, 2 by inspection.
